resources.string: Enter units — get a slab-wise bill estimate
Sanctioned load (kW) — printed on your bill
Actual bill adds: Fuel Price Adjustment, Quarterly adjustment, GST (~18%), TV fee (Rs 35), electricity duty — shown here is the base estimate only.
Over 200 units: protected rate can be lost (6-month average must stay ≤ 200 units).
Lifeline applies only up to 100 units/month — above that the non-protected slab applies.
Minimum monthly bill of Rs 75 applied.
This is not a government app. Rates follow the 12 Feb 2026 notification (S.R.O. 279(I)/2026) — verify with your bill.
